94592.overview: Magic Crayons intends to help the children to learn basic geometrical figures, colors and dexterity while coloring black&white scenes with the sensitive pen of the Pico system, placing geometrical forms, creating toys from different parts (choosing body, ears, eyes, etc...). A basic animation studio kit allows kids to create short cartoons.

147105.overview: Mike to Asobou Tobidase Milky Way (マイクとあそぼう とびだせミルキーウェイ) is an educational game for the Copera.

147106.overview: MiniMoni. Eigo de Asobundapyon! (ミニモニ。えいごであそぶんだぴょん！) is a Japanese-only Sega Pico game with cartoon depictions of Japanese band Minimoni.

147107.overview: MiniMoni. TV ni Derundapyon! (ミニモニ。テレビにでるんだぴょん！) is a Sega Pico educational game based on the cartoon likenesses of the Japanese band Minimoni.

147108.overview: MiniMoni. Shougakkou e Ikundapyon! (ミニモニ。小学校へ行くんだぴょん！) is a Sega Pico educational game based on the cartoon likenesses of the Japanese band Minimoni.

147109.overview: Minna de Odorou: Oz no Mahoutsukai (みんなでおどろう オズのまほうつかい) is a Sega Pico educational game based on The Wizard of Oz. The title is unique for being the first 16MB[2] game for the Pico.

147111.overview: Mo~tto! Ojamajo Doremi (も～っと！おジャ魔女どれみ) is a Sega Pico game based on the television show Ojamajo Doremi.

147112.overview: The Muppets On The Go! is a compilation of games including a Frogger clone, snowboarding and a maze game all based on the Muppets franchise. Kermit and his friends go on an adventure in this US-exclusive edutainment title. The player has a selection of mini-games including Gonzo's counting game, Rizzo's jigsaws, Kermit's river crossing arcade game, Fozzie's toy shop, Gonzo's snowboarding stunts and Kermit's animation sequencing.

147113.overview:
Musical Zoo, known as Do Re Mi Fa Animals no Tanoshii Ensoukai in Japan, is a Sega Pico game. There's a Zoo-full of animals ready to take your children on exciting musical adventures! They'll hop, fly, splash, waddle and buzz their way to uncover your child's hidden talents! Explore the world of instruments, notes, scales and more by playing wonderful musical games. With the help of animal "toons" from the story, your children will create and animate their own songs and melodies. Enjoy the world of music with a Zoo-full of animal teachers!

Test your musical ear with fun games!

Explore different instruments and their sounds!

Feel the beat as you discover tempo and rhythm!

Recognize notes and learn scales!

147121.overview: Moero! Robokon: Oekaki Robokon!! (おえかきロボコン!!) is a Sega Pico game.

147162.overview: Magic Knight Rayearth: Magic Knight Tanjou  is an educational game for the Sega Pico based on the Magic Knight Rayearth anime.

147164.overview: McDonald's de Asobo! is a Sega Pico game released by Sega Toys in 1999. It is a simple restaurant management simulator, which although is sponsored by the American fast-food chain McDonald's, was only released in Japan.

147166.overview: Melody Land is an educational game for the Copera.

147170.overview: Mezase Pro Yakyuu (めざせプロ野球) is an educational game for the Sega Pico with a baseball theme.

147171.overview: Mickey no Boku wa Meitantei (ミッキーのぼくはめいたんてい) is a Japanese-only Sega Pico game starring Mickey Mouse.

147172.overview: Mickey no Tokyo Disneyland Stamp Rally (ミッキーの東京ディズニーランド・スタンプラリー) is a Japanese-only Sega Pico game starring Mickey Mouse and various other classic Disney characters.

147173.overview:
Mickey no Yukai na Bouken (ミッキーのゆかいなぼうけん) is a Sega Pico game based on the Mickey Mouse franchise.

Though only released in Japan and South Korea, plans were put in place at one stage to bring the game to Germany as Mickys Lustiges Abenteuer. A prototype German ROM has since been released, and hints that it was due for release in 1995.

147174.overview: Mickey to Ooki na Furudokei (ミッキーと大きな古時計) is a Sega Pico game starring Mickey Mouse.

147175.overview: Mickey to Utau Tori no Shima: Minnie o Sagashite Waku Waku Daibouken! (ミッキーとうたうとりのしま ミニーをさがしてわくわくだいぼうけん!) is a Japanese-only Sega Pico game starring Mickey Mouse and various other classic Disney characters.

147176.overview: Take a magical journey through time with Mickey as he meets great inventors in history. Your children will learn about the calendar, how to tell time and about amazing inventions created by Leonardo Da Vinci, Thomas Edison and the Wright Brothers. Using characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartons!

147177.overview: Miimi to Taata no Waiwai Oekaki Doubutsuen (ミーミとタータのワイワイおえかきどうぶつえん) is a Sega Pico game.

147186.overview: The wonders of the world await discovery when your children ride Scholastic's The Magic School Bus. They'll travel into the Solar System and learn about planets and the space shuttle. In Dinosaur Land, children will hunt for fossils beneath the earth. To observe mysterious sea creatures, they'll journey to the depths of the Ocean. Children will even explore the Human Body. Using objects from the story and their own original art, your children will create their own adventures.

147270.overview: It's playful pups on the loose with Disney's 101 Dalmatians! Join Pongo and Perdita on exciting adventures when their lovable pups are kidnapped from their happy home. After choosing an easy or advanced level, children solve number problems while helping to rescue the puppies from evil Cruella De Vil. They'll learn to count by ones and tens and figure out size relationships, too. Using cute characters from the story and their own original art, your children will create and animate their own cartoon adventures!

147422.overview: Moshi Moshi Pico: Dare ga Deru kana Moshi Moshi Pico de TV to o-Shaberi! is a package for the Sega Pico, containing a Moshi Moshi Pico and the game, Dare ga Deru kana ? Moshi Moshi Pico de TV to o-Shaberi! (だれがでるかな？ もしもしピコでテレビとおしゃべり！), which was not sold separately.

457233.overview: My Grandfather's Farm is a Sega Pico game released in South Korea.
